    *   *Is "Rat Race" an occupation?*
        The clue `?g A3` (Work/Occupation) is a bit tricky for "Rat Race". "Rat Race" is a phrase *about* work. But in Concept, the `?g` icon indicates the *category* of the answer. If the answer is a phrase, the `?g` usually points to the main idea. If the answer is "Rat Race", the main idea is "Work/Life" or "A way of life".
